additional_concerns: The representation implements classification from supplied judgments. It does not implement asset identification, exposure measurement, LAF identification or holistic designation assessment. OMITS for these upstream matters is not by itself evidence that the Boolean trigger is defective.

The inclusive 50% threshold and the combination of direct and indirect exposures match the mandatory route in the source. The separate 15% direct-investment limit neither replaces this threshold nor permits omission of direct exposure from aggregation.

The unconditional designation OR preserves classification above 50%, where the exposure route already suffices. It must not be interpreted as granting unrestricted designation power or implementing the below-50% holistic assessment.

The conflict-anywhere rule adds an evidence-processing restriction not stated in the circular. A conflict in designation evidence can block evaluation despite an independently established exposure threshold; a conflict elsewhere can also prevent a scope exclusion from returning OUT_OF_SCOPE. This differs from the substantive sufficiency of either classification route and needs separate justification.

Missing evidence of designation is not evidence that no operative designation exists. A FALSE result requires known false inputs for both routes within known scope; it must not be read as general non-complex status or satisfaction of downstream duties.

The supplied source does not specify a quantitative aggregation methodology for derivatives, layered holdings, valuation timing or double counting. Which additional authority or SFC clarification is necessary remains unresolved; no supplied dependency ID identifies it.
The three unbound dependency IDs lack descriptive mappings and non-null source hashes. No AVAILABLE assessment or assignment of those IDs to named authorities is justified.

The separate LAF circular, UT Code section 7.3, sale authorities and any applicable home-regulator conditions are not supplied. Their absence has different consequences: the local LAF exclusion needs no external text, while assessing the referenced regimes or reconstructing fund-specific regulatory conditions would require additional material.

The source also references the Internal Product Approval Process guidance and Advertising Guidelines. Their texts are absent and their dependency IDs cannot be identified; they concern separate duties and are not additional prerequisites for this classification-only result.

For the holistic-assessment claim, PRESERVES is defensible only for its narrower consequence that below-threshold exposure is not a safe harbour. OMITS records that the full assessment procedure is not implemented. These interpretations should remain distinct rather than treating either label as a complete correctness verdict.

The source's designation factors are non-exhaustive and include strategy, portfolio composition, liquidity, risk profile and asset characteristics. Neither the listed factors nor the derivative examples independently establish a designation or permission to distribute.

No fund-specific facts or operative decision are supplied, so this proposal assesses source fidelity and executable correspondence only. It does not establish a Fund's classification, resolve measurement evidence or verify temporal applicability of the circular at a particular assessment date.
